name: Hon Hai Precision Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Hon Hai Precision Industry Co., Ltd., established in 1974 and headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, operates as a global provider of technology solutions. Its extensive reach encompasses Japan, Ireland, the United States, Singapore, China, Taiwan, and other international markets. The company's primary activities involve the manufacturing and sale of a diverse range of electronic components and finished products, catering to the information technology, communications, automotive, precision molding, and consumer electronics industries. Its product offerings include fundamental components such as connectors, cases, thermal modules, optical products, power supply units, and various wired and wireless communication devices. Furthermore, Hon Hai produces computer terminal monitors, data storage and processing equipment, application modules, network cable assemblies, WIFI cards, Bluetooth modules, CFTVs, DVRs, set-top boxes, optical network terminals, and portable cameras. Beyond product manufacturing, Hon Hai delivers advanced solutions for autonomous driving, new energy power, and Internet of Vehicles (IoV) systems. Its broad service portfolio includes planning, advisory, business operation and management, logistics, export processing, construction, leasing, and a wide array of information and software services. The company is also involved in educational technology development, holds numerous patent applications, and engages in the retail of office machinery and electronic appliances. A significant strategic focus lies in the robotics sector, with activities spanning reinvestment, software development, manufacturing, repair, after-sale support, and rental services for robots and automated equipment. Additionally, Hon Hai provides data storage services, installs computer and satellite television channels, and is active in mobile phone and broader telecom-related businesses.
